CapacitorUpdater._comment: OTA live web-bundle updates (no store review). autoUpdate is OFF on purpose: the app (src/lib/otaUpdate.js) drives updates itself so it can check the server kill-switch MOBILE_OTA_ENABLED (via /functions/mobileOtaConfig) BEFORE applying any bundle — flip that flag off to halt a rollout instantly (Apple 3.3.2 / Google compliance control). Updates download as DELTA bundles on wifi and apply on next open; a bad bundle auto-rolls back (notifyAppReady). Inert until '@capgo/capacitor-updater' is installed and a channel is set via the Capgo CLI. See MOBILE-OTA-LIVE-UPDATES.md.
